name: PENERGY
recent: PENERGY 于 2026 年 10 月 9 日宣布，其全资子公司 Petra Marine Sdn. Bhd. 与 PT Rajawali Perak Mulia 签署协议，以 450 万美元（约 1838 万令吉）现金出售名为 Petra Challenger 的船只。公司另于 10 月 1 日发布一项「其他」公告，但资料未提供具体内容。
notable: 全资子公司 Petra Marine Sdn. Bhd. 与 PT Rajawali Perak Mulia 签署协议，以 450 万美元（约 1838 万令吉）现金出售船只 Petra Challenger。

ann.title: TRANSACTIONS (CHAPTER 10 OF LISTING REQUIREMENTS) : NON RELATED PARTY TRANSACTIONS

recent_en: On 9 October 2026, PENERGY announced that its wholly-owned subsidiary Petra Marine Sdn. Bhd. entered into an agreement with PT Rajawali Perak Mulia to dispose of the vessel Petra Challenger for USD4.5 million (approximately RM18.38 million) in cash. The company also issued an 'Others' announcement on 1 October, but no details were provided.
notable_en: Wholly-owned subsidiary Petra Marine Sdn. Bhd. signed an agreement with PT Rajawali Perak Mulia to dispose of the vessel Petra Challenger for USD4.5 million (approximately RM18.38 million) in cash.
